name: Bjorn Stromberg
bio:
Bjorn's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. While serving as a mechanic in the Swedish army, his meticulous attention to detail caught the eye of a local rally team owner. He quickly transitioned from military vehicles to rally cars, honing his skills in diagnosing and resolving mechanical issues under pressure. This eventually led him to GT racing, where he worked his way up through various teams before landing at Ferrari AF Corse.

As a quality control specialist, Bjorn is known for his systematic approach and unwavering commitment to excellence. He believes that consistency is the key to success in endurance racing, meticulously inspecting every component and process to ensure they meet the highest standards. His colleagues appreciate his calm demeanor and ability to identify potential problems before they escalate. Bjorn's experience in diverse mechanical environments has instilled in him a deep understanding of how small details can have a significant impact on overall performance.

Beyond his technical expertise, Bjorn is valued for his collaborative spirit. He actively seeks input from engineers and mechanics, fostering a culture of open communication and shared responsibility. His dedication to process improvement and relentless pursuit of perfection make him a valuable asset to the Ferrari AF Corse team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight side part
physical.description: Bjorn is a man of sturdy build, radiating quiet competence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on using metric measurements, even when working with teams accustomed to imperial units.
